name: 蔡逸萍
objective:
本課程旨在介紹應用語言學 / 文學文化各領域重要議題與研究趨勢，以提供研究生在準備寫作研究論文時研究方向討論及導引。
This course introduces the main sub-disciplines, key issues and research trends in Applied Linguistics/Literature and Culture. It aims to provide graduate students with the fundamental knowledge and guidance needed for preparing and writing a research paper.
schedule:
week 5/Week 8 

1. Getting started
2. Thinking about methods
3. Reading for research
4. Managing your project
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
